topic: Theory: Naruto took in Kawaki because he finally got a second chance to answer a Nagato
title: Naruto Adopted Kawaki Because Of Nagato, Not Pity
description: Naruto's choice to take in Kawaki looks like kindness, but I think it is the answer he never got to give Nagato. Here is the theory, with the canon behind it. Do you buy it?
comment: Did Naruto adopt Kawaki to fix what happened with Nagato, or did he just see another lonely kid? Pick one.

lines.text: Naruto didn't adopt Kawaki out of pity. He learned it from Nagato.

shot.fallback: young man with orange hair beside a pale red haired man

lines.text: Here's my read, and I think it's almost perfect.

shot.fallback: blonde ninja leader looking over a village

lines.text: Remember Nagato? A boy raised by war, who decided the only answer to pain was more pain.

shot.fallback: red haired man with ringed purple eyes

lines.text: In chapter 437, Pain tells Naruto that death is the only road to peace.

shot.fallback: six bodies with piercings facing a blonde ninja

lines.text: And Naruto refuses to accept it.

shot.fallback: blonde ninja shouting in the rain

lines.text: Later, Nagato listens, and then spends his own life bringing back everyone he killed in Konoha.
Now jump to Boruto. Kawaki arrives as a weapon, raised by Kara to be a vessel.

shot.fallback: dark haired teenager with a mark on his hand

lines.text: He's violent. He's dangerous. He even turns on Boruto.
And Naruto still brings him home.

shot.fallback: older ninja with a hand on a teenager's shoulder

lines.text: People say Naruto only did it because Kawaki was alone, like he was. Fair.

shot.fallback: small blonde boy alone on a swing

lines.text: But being alone didn't save Nagato. Someone had to answer his pain with a home.
Nagato was the answer Naruto never got to give in time. Kawaki is the second chance.

shot.fallback: blonde man and teenager walking together

lines.text: Because Naruto didn't adopt Kawaki out of pity...

shot.fallback: young man with orange hair beside a pale red haired man
